visualCharacteristics: Centered title, line icon, pill button
contentPattern: Title sits above the icon in the source; the block CSS reorders it. Card text cell: title (p strong or h3), CTA link.
usage: Row of call-to-action tiles: centred title, line icon, pill button.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-3 short CTA tiles with an icon each. Use cards-overlay for image tiles and cards-logo for logo grids.
